title: Prevent duplicate model load and unload actions
goal: Make the Models tab visibly indicate engine transitions and prevent repeated load/unload taps while a model is loading or unloading.
context: Issue #367 prioritizes a complete GGUF/model workflow. ModelsScreen currently leaves the primary action enabled during lifecycle transitions, allowing redundant taps while the engine is busy.
forbidden_changes: Do not change GGUF validation, model storage, or provider runtime behavior.
Do not claim memory or thermal improvements without measurements.
Do not add new UI text without localization.
acceptance_criteria: The primary load/unload action is disabled while the engine is loading or unloading.
A progress indicator is shown during a transition.
Existing model failure details and lifecycle state remain visible.
verification: Review ModelsScreen lifecycle-state switch for all enum cases.
Run validate-contract, M3 and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA.
Verify on device that repeated taps are disabled during load/unload.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if Swift compilation fails or lifecycle states are misrepresented.
